## Have you ever wanted to become a Minecraft content creator? 
Well, now you can with a simple click of a button! With this modpack, you can create amazing Minecraft content without the struggle of finding all the right mods.

![A yellow and black striped line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/700b14cfa66c8b7b5b19b6b6f14a9cae82ed6f8d.png)

### Disclaimer [IMPORTANT]:
This is my first modpack. Please make sure you backup your Worlds, Configs, and other Files related to your Saves/Servers **BEFORE** updating to the newer versions of this Modpack.

![A yellow and black striped line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/700b14cfa66c8b7b5b19b6b6f14a9cae82ed6f8d.png)

### Key Features:
🎥 **_Flashback_** - Take your Storytelling to the next level. Create stunning cinimatic shots to elevate your videos.

🔍 **_WI Zoom_** - Capture funny moments from a far, without the use of spy-glasses or FOV changing.

📷 **_Fabrishot_** - Take high-quality screenshots of ingame moments to create stunning thumbnails and video assests.

⛏️ **_Litematica_** - Create amazing builds to make backgrounds for thumbnails, B-roll, and freecam shots.

🌐 **_Performance_** - Record high-quality footage, without the worry of lag or glitched recordings.

⛰️ **_Shaders_** - Create stunning worlds and beautiful shots to elevate your footage.

➕ **_Essentials_** - Equip different cosmetics, emotes, and skins for ingame use. Invite your friends and fellow content creators to private or public servers to elevate your footage to the next level.

![A yellow and black striped line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/700b14cfa66c8b7b5b19b6b6f14a9cae82ed6f8d.png)

### Tweaking:
This pack **SHOULD** be able to be used right after download, but you might want to consider tweaking the shader settings to your liking.

![A yellow and black striped line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/700b14cfa66c8b7b5b19b6b6f14a9cae82ed6f8d.png)

### Disclaimer [IMPORTANT]:
I do **NOT** own any of these mods. I only compiled them into this modpack.

![A yellow and black striped line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/700b14cfa66c8b7b5b19b6b6f14a9cae82ed6f8d.png)
